question.value: Does the spectroscopic dense gas fraction (HCN/CO) correlate with the cloud-scale (120 pc) molecular gas surface density in nearby galaxies?

evidence.quote: We use ALMA and IRAM 30-m telescope data to investigate the relationship between the spectroscopically-traced dense gas fraction and the cloud-scale (120 pc) molecular gas surface density in five nearby, star-forming galaxies.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA #2015.1.00956.S, ADS/JAO.ALMA #2013.1.00634.S, ADS/JAO.ALMA #2011.0.00004.SV.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: HCN seven-field mosaic; 10 km/s channels for HCN; 2.5 km/s for CO(2-1)

evidence.quote: ALMA observed HCN (1-0) using a seven-field mosaic centered on the nucleus of the galaxy.
We estimate the dense gas mass fraction at 650 pc and 2800 pc scales using the ratio of HCN (1-0) to CO (1-0) emission.
We then use high resolution (120 pc) CO (2-1) maps
